# Synthetic computer_use_demo_v1

This source fixture is compiled by the existing Skill registry into a validated,
hash-bound version 1.0.0 package in pytest temporary storage. The recording and
policy are deliberately harmless synthetic values, not a deployable UTM mapping.
Nothing is installed into an operator Profile, and these test adapters are not
included in the distribution manifest.

The two inspectable PPM images encode a 4×4 RGB desktop: the black 2×2 top-left
navigation button, top-right form field and bottom-left submit button stay black;
the bottom-right result region becomes green only after navigating, writing the
host-supplied specimen label and submitting. The model supplies a declared value
key, never the actual text. PNG observations and RGB anchor/postcondition hashes are derived
from these files. The adapter also persists a synthetic result JSON and requires
both that file and the postcondition pixels for verification. Tests use real
settings, package/compiler, agent, tool registration, bridge HTTP client, durable
worker ledger and artifact writer. Only native input and HTTP/model boundaries
are replaced. No network or devices are available in the validation sandbox.
